coordinate_convention: masks retain raw GridSag workbook row order [row,column]; row 0 is physical +Y. physical_y_mm is aligned with rows and therefore descending

zone_semantics.far_reference: high-purity far plateau used for Far/Add prescription metrics
zone_semantics.near_reference: high-purity near plateau used for Far/Add prescription metrics
zone_semantics.far: broader far functional region for review and parameterization density
zone_semantics.near: broader near functional region for review and parameterization density
zone_semantics.corridor: connected progressive region between far and near functional plateaus
zone_semantics.peripheral_astig: union of left/right high-astigmatic lateral wings outside far/near/corridor
zone_semantics.peripheral_astig_left: left high-astigmatic lateral wing anchored to the monitored aperture side
zone_semantics.peripheral_astig_right: right high-astigmatic lateral wing anchored to the monitored aperture side
zone_semantics.monitored: trimmed valid aperture used for local Power/Astig change constraints
